Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Joron Keshen: 32-year-old woman, 165 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-4-medium. Face: square compact face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, asymmetric-extreme, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: one small nape tattoo; a dense freckle field. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
